text: Residents on Glebeholme Boulevard, between Greenwood Avenue and Caithness Avenue, shared significant traffic safety concerns with my office. They completed a confidential ballot showing majority support for the installation of speed humps on Glebeholme.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of traffic calming (four speed humps) on Glebeholme Boulevard, between Caithness Avenue and Greenwood Avenue, generally as shown in Attachment 2 to the letter (July 9, 2026) from Councillor Paula Fletcher.
